 Hon'Ble Sandeep Jain, J. 
1.

The instant appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act has been filed by the appellant
against the impugned Award and Decree dated 12.05.1994 passed by the Court of Sri Chandra
Prakash, VIth Additional District Judge, Varanasi in L.A.R. No.57 of 1988, Purshottam vs. Collector,
Varanasi, whereby compensation at the rate of Rs. 2560/- per decimal has been awarded to the
landowners for their acquired land situated in Village Kanchanpur, Pargana Dehat Amanat, District-
Varanasi.

2. Learned Standing Counsel for the State submitted that the matter for acquisition of land situated in Village Kanchanpur, Pargana Dehat Amanat, District- Varanasi vide notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 06.11.1982 for establishing the Diesel Locomotive Works at Varanasi has attained finality because the State had earlier challenged the Award of the Reference Court by filing First Appeal No. 183 of 2003 (State of UP v. Bachharam) which was decided by this Court vide order dated 25.11.2016 whereby the Award of the Reference Court was affirmed by this Court against which, no appeal was preferred before the Apex Court.
Learned Standing Counsel submitted that in view of the above order of this Court, the instant appeal be also decided.
3. None is present for the respondents.
4. I have heard the learned Standing Counsel for the State and perused the record.

5. It is apparent that in the instant appeal, the matter relates to acquisition of land situated in Village Kanchanpur, Pargana Dehat Amanat, District- Varanasi for establishing Diesel Locomotive Works at Varanasi.
The notification under Section 4(1) of the Act was issued on 06.11.1982, the Award of the Collector was made on 17.05.1986 and the possession of the land was taken on 19.09.1986.

The Reference Court awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 2560/- per decimal along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
6.

It is apparent that previously, the State had challenged the Award of the Reference Court in similar matters by filing First Appeal No. 183 of 2003 (State of UP v. Bachharam) connected with 26 first appeals, which were dismissed by this Court vide order dated 25.11.2016.

sentences.text: In these appeals, First Appeal Nos. 10 of 1995, 481 of 1993 and 60 of 1994 were filed by the landowners which were also dismissed by the Court.

sentences.text:
It is apparent that the above appeals filed by the landowners for enhancement of amount of compensation and by the State/ Union of India for reducing the compensation awarded by the Reference Court, both have been dismissed by this Court vide above order dated 25.11.2016 which has not been challenged by the parties by filing appeal before the Apex Court, as such, the matter regarding Award of compensation for land acquired for establishing Diesel Locomotive Works at Varanasi has attained finality.
7.

The instant appeal has been filed by the State for reducing the amount of compensation of Rs.
2560/- per decimal awarded by the Reference Court which cannot be reduced any further in the light of the order dated 25.11.2016 passed by this Court in the above-mentioned appeals.

As such,
the instant appeal is meritless and is liable to be dismissed.
